decision_conditions:
This decision confirms that the revised wording for condition 8 of planning consent ref: P2024/3002/FUL is:

“SECURED BY DESIGN: (A) Prior to works commencing of the development hereby approved, details of how the development addresses Secured by Design requirements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. (B) The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved prior to first occupation. 

REASON: In the interests of safety and security.”
description: Non-Material Amendment following a grant of planning permission: P2024/3002/FUL dated 08/07/2025 for ‘landscaping works to disused ball court to create communal garden space with associated works including entrance gates and fencing vision panels.’ Amendments seek to amend the wording of condition 8 (Secure by Design Details) in line with recent Design Out Crime feedback.
